cohort: The study included 3400 pregnant women attending an antenatal care clinic.
finding: The overall prevalence of maternal hypothyroidism in pregnancy was 10.5% (3.3% overt and 7.2% subclinical), and both overt and subclinical hypothyroidism were associated with adverse maternal and fetal effects.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery rate was significantly higher in overt hypothyroid patients (16.8%) compared with subclinical cases (12.6%).
